learnings.title: Treasury auction schedule is not an auction result
learnings.claim: The U.S. Treasury distinguishes a tentative six-month auction schedule from actual auction announcements and results; its official Treasury Auction Query provides downloadable auction data. A scheduled auction alone is not evidence of its final yield, bid-to-cover or allotted amount.
learnings.decision: FINANCE_TREASURY_AUCTION_STATUS_GATE: Require final official auction results for the exact security, maturity and auction date before quoting yield or bid-to-cover. FINANCE_TREASURY_PRELIMINARY_RESULT_GATE: Preliminary noncompetitive results cannot establish final competitive high yield or bid-to-cover. FINANCE_TREASURY_REOPENING_IDENTITY_GATE: Reopenings may share CUSIP and maturity but differ in issue date and price; require auction date, issue date, CUSIP, security type, maturity and final result type, otherwise withhold numerical conclusions. Actual Finance decision artifacts must record applied_learning_ids.
learnings.next_measurement: Run Finance decision consumer against a specific final Treasury auction result and a preliminary/mismatched result; verify the gate and applied_learning_ids in the resulting report.
fallback_history: If final results are unavailable, report only announcement status and keep yield/bid-to-cover unknown.
Do not match reopened auctions by CUSIP alone.
